[C] Additional Conditions of Contract: 1) The contractor/agency participating in the tender should normally be GST compliant regarding registration, filing of returns etc., and shall be fully responsible for the co mpliance as per GST Act at all times. environment for users of the vehicles. Norma lly, Service provider shall provide vehicle as per contract on demand basis. However , due to non-availability of vehicle /unavoidable situations, if a lower segment vehicl e is provided against the order/demand for higher segment vehicle, the payment will be made for lower segment only. 5) In case of breakdown of the hired vehicle, the service provider has to provide an alte rnate vehicle within 30 minutes from the time of breakdown 6) No night charges will be payable. 7) The substitute vehicle offered shall not be older than the vehicle under breakdown at any point of ti me during the currency of contract. 8) No mileage will be allowed for Drivers’ lunch / breakfast or for drawl of Petrol / Dies el / CNG etc. 9) The average running of vehicles and duty hours may at times exceed the limit of ho urs and kilometers in a day. 10) The Driver of the vehicle will maintain log-sheets in respect of each vehicle run and the same should be attached to the bill. He should possess valid Driving License. He should be in proper neat and clean uniform and be punctual, with name badge/identity card etc. 15) The hiring vehicles provided by the agency may be required to ply in Delhi NCR area s such as NOIDA, Ghaziabad and Gurugram and therefore, vehicles supplied should be fit to ply in all such areas. 16) The contractor shall assign the job of driving a hired vehicle only to qualified experie

nced license drivers and also assume full responsibility for the safety and security of the officer/officials as well as essential store items while running the vehicle by ensu ring safe driving.
